steps.title: Configure Project Build Specifications
steps.description: Configuring Gradle build settings, target SDK 34, namespace com.varshalaxmi.loanmanager, and Temurin 17 Java compatibility.

steps.title: Define Database Architecture & Relational Helper
steps.description: Constructing offline SQLite DatabaseHelper supporting multi-loan accounts, additions, repayment logs, interest formulas, and app preferences.

steps.title: Design Material Theme Colors & Style Guidelines
steps.description: Defining VarshaLaxmi visual theme resources, gold accent highlights, dark green headers, and typography styles.

steps.title: Build Dashboard Core & Analytics Overview UI
steps.description: Designing main financial stats dashboard layout with real-time portfolio metrics and standard button launcher grid.

steps.title: Construct Borrower Management Screen & Adapters
steps.description: Creating real-time search interface, list adapter, and summary item layouts for borrower management.

steps.title: Build Borrower Registration & Profile Edit Form
steps.description: Implementing borrower profile registration and editing activity with input validation.

steps.title: Implement Detailed Borrower Portfolio & Reminders UI
steps.description: Creating complete borrower profile with combined statement cards, active loan lists, and WhatsApp reminder integration.

steps.title: Develop Multi-Mode Loan Issuance Engine
steps.description: Coding new loan screen supporting Mode A (new loan creation) and Mode B (top-up existing active loan) with dynamic interest rate calculation options.

steps.title: Implement Payment Collection & Split Allocator
steps.description: Building collection activity supporting automated principal/interest split as well as manual custom allocation.

steps.title: Build Loan Ledger & Filtered Register Activity
steps.description: Developing filtered loan ledger view with tab filters for Active, Closed, and All loan accounts.

steps.title: Implement Payment History & Date Filter Log
steps.description: Creating historical payment collection log activity with date filtering and payment breakdown views.

steps.title: Build Portfolio Analytics & Financial Reports
steps.description: Implementing aggregate financial reporting for capital disbursed, collections received, and total pure interest earned.

steps.title: Integrate SAF Database Backup & Restore Manager
steps.description: Implementing Storage Access Framework export and import handlers for local offline database backups.

steps.title: Implement Security PIN Lock & App Settings
steps.description: Coding security lock screen, passcode verification, and app preferences manager.

steps.title: Building VarshaLaxmi
steps.description: Assembling native Android APK binary with zero external dependencies.
